title: Tatuerad · vila · ser ned och ler
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: från och till ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. She blinks and lowers her eyes for a moment, then lifts them to the camera again, and a small smile comes and goes: her lips stay together as the corners of her mouth lift a little. Her head tilts a little to one side with the smile and comes back. Her face stays towards the camera all the way. Her hands stay exactly where they are. The plain green background, the shoe and the edges of the picture stay exactly as in the first frame all the way. The tattoos on her hands and throat keep their pattern.
